entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: [fName] getting captured by the[n]police went exactly how we planned it.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: And I had been interrogating him with[n]no knowledge of this.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: But, how did you lure Akechi into this...[n]cognitive world's interrogation room?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: All I needed were the coordinates.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hehehehehe...
It seems like she used this laptop to[n]remotely access the Metaverse...
Asking her about it now would drag[n]the conversation on too long...[n]I should talk to her later.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Akechi disposed of the fake in the[n]Palace, and left thinking he had been[n]victorious.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It must have been truly hilarious for[n]our leader who sat idly in the real[n]world's interrogation room.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Surely he was acting quite cocky[n]by himself in that quiet chamber.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: So that's why you gave me your[n]phone... I only took it because of[n]what you told me.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It's a shame I didn't have the[n]opportunity to see that for myself.
I couldn't see it either.
There was no time.
I'm just glad I didn't die.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: All I could do was try to handle all the[n]messages that started coming to me[n]on his phone.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Huh...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: So in other words, I've been to the[n]Metaverse, albeit for a brief moment.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: In our experience, there is little[n]danger when someone enters their[n]own Palace for so short a time.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: That's the other reason we had him[n]give it to you.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: We needed you to listen to Alibaba,[n]deceive the guard, and ultimately[n]aid in his escape.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: By having you head back to the[n]interrogation room, we could return[n]you to the real world as well.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I mean, I had to think of some way to[n]keep you from running into Akechi[n]mid-assassination.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...Astounding.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I hadn't the slightest idea that such[n]a grand operation was taking place[n]within me.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm so glad [fName] was able to[n]persuade you during the interrogation.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Even though we knew Akechi's plan,[n]we were pretty worried about that part.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: True.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Why's that?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Without Sis on our side, Futaba's[n]plan and subsequent breakout would[n]have never been possible.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That persuasion was easily our[n]greatest gamble.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We couldn't consult Sis beforehand.[n]It was absolutely the make-or-break[n]moment of the entire plan.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Still, I'm surprised you could[n]convince me in such a short time.[n]Were you confident you could do it?
I was.
Not at all.
Don't remember. Drugs.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I see...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Then it truly was a do or die[n]situation? That's crazy.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Understandable...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Either way, I can't believe you went[n]for such a risky idea...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If we could just tell you the true[n]culprit's plan, I knew you'd realize[n]the bigger picture...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Realize that [fName] was telling[n]the truth, and that there was a[n]greater evil to pursue.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: As a result, we emerged victorious.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Then the reason you kept this a[n]secret from me was so you could[n]catch the true culprit, correct?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes. Plus, you had lost control of[n]yourself at the time...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: This is stunning... All I can really do[n]is laugh.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I've kinda figured out that you guys[n]made Akechi kill a fake...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: But what did you do about the body?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: The police never even checked it.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Huh?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: They had a coroner working to[n]ensure [fName]-kun's death[n]was reported as a suicide.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: That coroner didn't take one look[n]at the scene, and just passed along[n]a falsified death certificate.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...The bad guys have that much[n]influence?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Murder in a police station would be[n]reckless otherwise. We also knew of[n]a possible conspirator.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Thanks to Futaba-chan's messages[n]and the guard's demeanor, I[n]eventually came to understand...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: And since the higher-ups at the[n]police knew nothing of this, they[n]were thrown into disarray.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: As a result, [fName]-kun's suicide[n]during imprisonment was reported on[n]the news, just as Akechi planned.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And with that confusion, he was able[n]to escape with Niijima-san's help.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I made sure nobody would check the[n]morgue for his body, and thanks to[n]that, nobody knows he survived.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Thinking back to the interrogation[n]though... I can't believe what they[n]did to [fName].

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The callous use of violence and even[n]drugs is utterly abnormal.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If he had lost consciousness and[n]hadn't been able to tell Sis about the[n]phone, he would've died...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm... truly glad you made it back safe,[n][fName].
It was close.
I don't remember much.
It was a breeze.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I almost became one of your[n]assailants as well...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Don't. You shouldn't have to[n]remember such things...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: How tough are you?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It still freaked me out when I saw the[n]suicide on the news though.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: We made sure to live normal lives[n]while he was being interrogated to[n]avoid drawing any suspicion.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Even with that, I couldn't help but[n]worry for him in my heart...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, I knew right away that our plan[n]worked out.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I wanted to believe... but considering[n]what we were up against...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Ryuji's a bit on the dense and[n]carefree side.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Can it, cat!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I had to be patient and avoid this[n]place until things settled down.[n]I finally feel relieved...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We knew he was alive, but... it was[n]difficult to not worry until we could[n]confirm it in person.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Now that I think about it, my[n]interrogation was just a formality[n]for the head commander.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: What a joke letting me interrogate[n]someone who was meant to die.[n]They just wanted to avoid backlash...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Very well. From here forward, I will[n]do my utmost to assist you.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...You saved me, after all.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's reassuring to hear.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I'll do whatever I can to help too.[n]Just let me know.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Let's take a break for now though.[n]This old brain is pooped.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh, and feel free to use the first floor[n]when you guys want to get together[n]to talk.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You'll need a hideout where you can[n]be safe. Just say the word and I'll[n]close shop early.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Are you sure?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: This guy can't leave. Plus, you won't[n]make much progress if people can[n]hear you from downstairs.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: It's not like this place is the liveliest[n]joint in town. It won't be a huge loss[n]for me.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Let us accept his offer.[n]What a great man...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Heheh.
